metadata.title: Using Land and Probate Records in Family History Research Laurie Bradshaw
metadata.author: Gary Foster
metadata.shortDescription:
Join with Laurie Bradshaw, an experienced genealogist in this Mesa FamilySearch Library webcast.

Learn what Land and Probate records to research your ancestors and learn more about the origin of their surname, where they lived, and how they lived.

Begin your journey to learn who you are and the opportunities you now have because of the real experiences they had to endure for your freedoms.

Laurie recorded this video in front of a live audience in Mesa, Arizona in 2016, and shares this recording with you hoping you will learn the basic tools to assist you in your research.

Laurie is an experienced researcher and this video will assist you in your family history research.
keywords: using land records to trace your family history
using probate records to trace your family history
